description: SL-IO: shifts each of Solim's values an octave up or down after limiting, and can either replace the original value or add the shifted one beside it; it goes to the left of the Solim module

params.text: Shifts that value an octave up or down after limiting, or leaves it alone, with the middle position taking no action
Chooses whether the octave shift happens before the sort, so it changes the sort order, or after it, so the sort works on the original value
Replaces the original value with the shifted one when it is lit; unlit, the original stays and the shifted value is added to the end of the sequence

inputs.text: Replaces that row's shift switch while it is patched: a positive voltage shifts up, a negative one shifts down, and 0V takes no action
Replaces that row's timing switch while it is patched: a positive voltage shifts after the sort, 0V or below shifts before it
Replaces that row's replace button while it is patched: a positive voltage replaces the original, 0V or below keeps it and adds the shifted value

notes: this expander is placed to the left of the Solim module; only one is allowed in a chain, and the lamp at the top turns green when it is connected
with the shift switch in its middle position and the replace button lit, the original value is removed from the sequence and nothing is added in its place
the rows work on the Solim inputs of the same number, and shifting can take the sequence up to sixteen values, of which the first eight reach the outputs
